headline: This law directs Congress to remove a bust of Chief Justice Roger Taney from the Capitol and add a bust of Justice Thurgood Marshall.
what_it_does: The law tells the Joint Committee on the Library to take down the bust of Roger Brooke Taney in the Old Supreme Court Chamber of the Capitol. It also directs the committee to obtain a bust of Thurgood Marshall and install it in a prominent place in the Capitol or on the Capitol Grounds. The committee should look first for a spot near the Old Supreme Court Chamber.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 27, 2022.
